properties.name: The agent-graph read path stops recomputing loop_status, re-parsing dead sync files, and re-scanning defects per rollup
properties.rationale: WHAT IT TRADED, as the optimize skill requires. (1) reverses dec:read-hint-shape option C's debt half - reads no longer carry a loop-debt pointer; the trade is that mid-session debt now reaches the agent only via the loop_status call it is instructed to make and the Stop hook, not via ordinary reads. Anthony chose this knowing it. (2) and (3) each add a cache; the skill warns a cache is a global. Both hold a DERIVED result over a graph state and both invalidate at the write, so a stale entry can only ever be a stale count, never lost design - and (3)'s generation lives on the one object every write already touches, so no future write path can miss it. RESULT, measured and recorded in full on fact:the-three-perf-changes-killed-the-multiplier-and-two-budgets-hold-one-misses-on-my-own-derivation: read-after-write 5,900x -> 1.41x (the headline - the hint ran a full loop_status 9.5x a session), loop_status warm 12,502 -> 1,912 ms, sync 3,556 -> 75 ms. ONE BUDGET MISSED HONESTLY: the orientation pass is 11,103 ms cold vs an 8,000 target I derived on a scan-only model that ignored the rollups' own ~2.8 s costs. loop_status after a write is still ~6.3 s because computing the defect count once is intrinsically ~5 s - a SEPARATE optimization (make the scan faster) that was not approved and not started.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Three changes to the LLM-agent-to-graph leg, each with a budget written before the code (con:a-read-after-a-write-costs-at-most-twice-the-same-read-warm, con:loop-status-warm-latency-ms, con:a-full-orientation-pass-costs-at-most-8-seconds). (1) read_loop_hint no longer runs a full loop_status to append a debt sentence; the loop speaks on loop_status, and record_moved is kept on reads. (2) sync_debt answers an unchanged target from a stored (hash,len,mtime,nodes) observation instead of re-reading and re-parsing it; a stat pre-check (any_target_moved) short-circuits the read path. (3) open_defects and detect_gaps are memoised per write generation, the generation carried on ReadCache so every backend write invalidates it. Files: cache.rs, engine/mod.rs, graph.rs, heal.rs, detect.rs, provenance.rs (core); service.rs, sync_debt.rs (mcp). Tests: ver:a-derived-scan-runs-once-per-write-generation (3, structure not duration), the rewritten read-hint test in tools.rs, and the sync tests. core 1578/0, mcp 343/0, fmt and clippy clean.
